features.name: User Registration + Clerk Auth
features.description: Users can sign up and log in via Clerk with email, Google, and GitHub OAuth. Session management and logout included.
acceptance_criteria: Users can sign up with email, Google, or GitHub
Users can log in and maintain a session
Users can log out
Clerk webhook syncs new users to Convex users table
Unauthenticated users are redirected to sign-in

features.name: Analytics Integration
features.description: PostHog SDK integrated to track key user events across the application.
acceptance_criteria: PostHog JS SDK initialized on app load
Signup event tracked
Onboarding completion event tracked
Match accept/pass events tracked
Message sent events tracked

features.name: Onboarding Flow
features.description: Seven-step structured onboarding collecting age, location, skills, commitment, working styles, values, and personality data.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding is required before accessing the dashboard
Seven steps displayed sequentially with progress indicator
Step 1: Date of birth with 18+ validation and city selection from static list
Step 2: Skill selection from predefined categories
Step 3: Commitment level and startup intent selection
Step 4: Work style and communication preferences
Step 5: Core values selection
Step 6: Personality trait scales
Users can navigate back to previous steps
All responses saved to Convex onboarding_responses table

features.name: Profile Creation
features.description: After onboarding, users can view and edit their profile with free-form fields including introduction, founder pitch, background, and additional notes.
acceptance_criteria: Profile page displays all onboarding data and free-form fields
Users can edit introduction, founder pitch, background, and notes
Users can update onboarding responses from profile
Profile data persisted to Convex profiles table
Profile is viewable by matched users

features.name: Avatar Creation
features.description: Users select and customize an avatar using the boring-avatars library during onboarding step 7.
acceptance_criteria: Avatar displayed using boring-avatars React component
Users can choose from multiple avatar variants
Avatar seed and variant saved to user record
Avatar renders consistently across the app (profile, matches, messages)
No file upload or storage required

features.name: Matching Algorithm
features.description: Convex server function computes weighted compatibility scores across all onboarding dimensions and generates match pairs.
acceptance_criteria: Matching uses weighted scoring across skills, commitment, values, working style, and personality
Scores are normalized to a 0-100 scale
Score breakdown stored per match
Users are not re-matched with previously seen users
Matching runs when users complete onboarding and periodically

features.name: Email Notifications
features.description: Transactional emails sent via Resend for key events: welcome, new match, match expiry, and new messages.
acceptance_criteria: Welcome email sent on signup
New match notification email sent when a match is created
Match expiry reminder email sent before expiration
New message notification email sent for unread messages
Users can manage email notification preferences
Emails sent via Resend API from Convex actions

features.name: Match Display
features.description: Users see their current matches with alignment summaries and can accept or pass on each match.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows current pending match with alignment summary
Score breakdown visible per matching dimension
Users can accept or pass on a match
Mutual acceptance creates a connection
Connected matches shown in a separate list
Match partner profile viewable from match card

features.name: Match Expiry
features.description: Matches expire after a fixed time window if not acted upon. Convex cron job handles expiration and notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Matches have an expiry timestamp set on creation
Convex cron job runs periodically to expire stale matches
Expired matches are marked and removed from active view
Users are notified of expired matches via email
Expiry countdown visible on match card

features.name: Limited Messaging
features.description: Connected users can exchange a limited number of messages to encourage moving to video calls.
acceptance_criteria: Messaging available only for connected (mutually accepted) matches
Message count limit enforced per match
Real-time message delivery via Convex subscriptions
Message input disabled when limit is reached
Remaining message count displayed to users
New message notifications sent

features.name: Video Call Nudge
features.description: After messaging begins, users are prompted to schedule a video call via a Cal.com link displayed in the conversation view.
acceptance_criteria: Cal.com scheduling link displayed in match conversation view
Nudge appears after first message exchange
Link opens Cal.com in a new tab
Nudge becomes more prominent as message limit approaches
No Cal.com SDK integration required
